# Vemian

> Homes for rent in Vancouver, BC, run by Michael. Every home on the site is open now, with real photos, the monthly rent and the move-in date. Viewings by appointment; applications online at https://www.vemianpm.com/apply.

Contact: Michael, text 604-213-1171 (texts only) or email contact@vemianpm.com. English and Spanish.

### Mount Pleasant

Main Street’s cafés, restaurants and independent shops, with groceries and transit a few steps from the door.

- [The Independent at Main #302, 2508 Watson Street](https://www.vemianpm.com/?home=watson-302): 2 bed + flex, 1 bath, 705 sq ft, $3,150/month, available now. Junior two-bedroom + flex with A/C. Pets: cats and dogs welcome. Includes hydro (electricity).

### Cambie Village

Leafy streets along and off Cambie Street, close to its shops and restaurants, Queen Elizabeth Park, schools and the Canada Line.

- [Hillcrest Manor #201, 3850 Cambie Street](https://www.vemianpm.com/?home=cambie-201): 1 bed, 1 bath, 750 sq ft, $2,150/month, available Dec 1. Large, bright one-bedroom near King Edward Station. Pets: one cat welcome.

### Marpole

A quiet south Vancouver neighbourhood around Oak Street and Marine Drive, with parks nearby and Highway 99 minutes away.

- [911 West 71st Avenue #2](https://www.vemianpm.com/?home=w71-2): Studio, 1 bath, 500 sq ft, $1,580/month, available Dec 1. Spacious studio next to a park. Pets: one trained cat welcome. Includes heat, hot water.
